title: Vaile Mansion
geometryBasis: Named native footprint including attached elements, Historic American Buildings Survey exterior coverage, and public-domain color photography.
sectionBasis: A brick Second Empire house with a tall east tower, multicolored slate mansard, bracketed pale trim, full-width east veranda and the south window bays. Vertical proportions use the registered east-front width and window and cornice ratios of the HABS and Highsmith elevations.
limitations: The measured local widths come from the mapped outline. Heights and secondary projections are approximate exterior proportions inferred from the frontal and oblique archival views.
Scope includes the standing mansion and attached rear wing. Any detached greenhouse or carriage house is excluded.
Some smaller ornament and rear openings are approximate.
